contractor_review: Keep the measuring visit separate from installation. Set a visit fee before sending a priced quote.
homeowner_estimate:
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
Laundry alcove measurement. I’ll measure the alcove for a possible side-by-side layout. Your washer and dryer are not approved as a stack. This visit covers measurement only.

contractor_review: The $155 includes the new cord. The installer confirmed the cord and receptacle match.
homeowner_estimate: Electric dryer connection — $155. I’ll supply and fit the approved new cord, connect the dryer to the existing receptacle, reconnect the vent and run a test.

contractor_review: Outlet and clearances verified. Retain the tank setup and customer demonstration.
homeowner_estimate: Ventless dryer setup — $145. I’ll set and level the dryer, run a test with its collection tank and show you how to empty it. This model uses the tank without a duct or drain hookup.

contractor_review: Access is checked. Book the move after the owner’s trades have prepared and tested the upstairs services.
homeowner_estimate: Washer relocation — $250. Once your plumber and electrician have tested the upstairs connections, I’ll move the washer from the basement to the closet and reconnect it there. The dryer stays downstairs. You arrange the plumbing and electrical work separately.

contractor_review: The owner supplies the plug-in replacement and retains the old unit. The $180 includes the flange swap and tests. An independent plumber posts about $290 labor; an eligible retailer install lists $179. These are different service arrangements; preserve the supplied $180.
homeowner_estimate: Garbage disposal replacement — $180. I’ll remove the old disposal and flange, install your matching plug-in disposal and flange, reconnect it and test for operation and leaks. I’ll leave the old unit with you.

contractor_review: There’s no installation to book. The owner’s plumber must establish the drain route before you can quote installation.
homeowner_estimate:
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
Wet-bar ice maker. Please have your plumber check whether the required drain can be provided. After you have the findings, I can quote installation separately. No installation is authorized at this stage.

contractor_review: Use the approved open location and existing verified outlet. The price is for placement and test.
homeowner_estimate: Freestanding wine cooler setup — $95. I’ll place the cooler in the open location we agreed on, level it and test operation at the existing outlet. The cabinet door installation is outside this scope.

contractor_review: The $1,800 covers your labor for the vanity, mirror and wall painting. Confirm who supplies wall paint before sending. The owner pays the electrician directly.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Bathroom refresh, $1,800 fixed labor. I’ll replace your owner-supplied mirror and vanity in the existing location and paint the bathroom walls. We’ll confirm who supplies the paint before booking. You hire and pay your electrician directly for the new light. The shower and floor stay in place. Before booking, we’ll also confirm the new vanity footprint and that the existing hookups suit it.

contractor_review: Carry one $4,600 demolition-and-tile price. Confirm the demo limits and surfaces to receive tile before sending the final scope.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Bathroom demolition and tile, $4,600. I’ll remove the finishes we mark together, haul away the demolition debris and install the tile you supply after the GC hands over the signed-off waterproofed substrate. Before booking we’ll identify the surfaces to remove and tile. Plumbing and shower glass are handled separately by others.

contractor_review: Confirm who buys the 18 fronts and hardware before sending. Leave measuring, supply and installation of tops with the fabricator.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Cabinet fronts and hardware, $2,500 for installation. I’ll fit 18 new fronts and their hardware to the existing cabinet boxes. We’ll confirm who supplies the fronts and hardware before booking. The appliances stay. Your fabricator measures and installs the countertops and bills you directly.

contractor_review: $3,200 is for the approved selective demo and haul only. Owner’s trades disconnect first; the GC identifies the limits and handles design and rebuild.
homeowner_estimate: Selective kitchen demolition — $3,200. After your trades disconnect the utilities, I’ll remove the approved nonstructural cabinets and finishes and haul the debris away. Wall removal is outside this phase. Your GC handles the layout and rebuild.

contractor_review: The $175 review doesn’t establish whether the wall is load-bearing. Owner arranges the engineer separately.
homeowner_estimate: Basement wall site review — $175. I’ll visit to review the proposed opening and visible conditions. Your engineer will assess whether the wall carries load. This visit includes no demolition or structural determination.

contractor_review: Keep the $800 limited to recording existing conditions. Confirm what views and format the owner/designer needs before sending the drawing scope.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Existing garage drawings, $800. I’ll measure the detached garage and draw its existing conditions. We’ll agree on the drawing views and file format before booking. You and your designer determine whether the conversion is feasible. Design approval, permits and construction are outside this price.

contractor_review: The engineer approved storage use in the marked area. The $1,250 also covers hatch trim.
homeowner_estimate: Attic storage platform — $1,250. I’ll build the 80 sq ft storage platform in the engineer-approved marked area and trim the access hatch. This is a storage platform only. Bedroom conversion and HVAC work are outside the estimate.

contractor_review: The owner supplies all finish materials and the GC completes the shell and trades. Confirm the trim runs and shelving layout before booking.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Bedroom trim and closet shelving, $2,150. After drywall and paint are finished, I’ll install the interior trim and closet shelving in one bedroom using the materials you supply. We’ll confirm the trim locations and shelving layout before booking. Your GC handles the shell and trades.

contractor_review: Preserve one $3,600 price including paint and the sample visit. Agree which six rooms before booking.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Six-room wall repaint, $3,600 fixed including paint. We’ll confirm the six rooms before booking. I’ll make one sample visit before painting, then paint the walls in those rooms. Please move the furniture. The ceilings and trim stay as they are.

contractor_review: Confirm board material and replacement limits before sending. Hidden rot is outside the $2,900 until the owner approves a separate written price.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Deck board replacement, $2,900. We’ll confirm the board selection and deck area before booking. I’ll remove and dispose of the old boards and install new boards and fasteners over the existing framing. If lifting the boards exposes rot, I’ll show you the damage and quote the affected framing repair for your written approval before proceeding there.

contractor_review: GC confirmed the drawing. Schedule after the footing handoff. Both rails are in the $2,400.
homeowner_estimate: Porch stair rebuild — $2,400. Once the new footings installed by others are ready, I’ll rebuild the four steps and both rails to the approved drawing. The porch deck stays.

contractor_review: Net fence is 60 ft after removing the 4 ft gate opening. Confirm fence height, material and gate style before sending.
homeowner_estimate: Draft — Side fence and gate replacement, $2,850. On the approved line, I’ll remove the old fence and gate and dispose of them for $350. I’ll install 60 ft of fence at $35/ft ($2,100) and the gate in the 4 ft opening for $400. Posts are included. We’ll confirm height, material and gate style before booking.

contractor_review: Address the moving hinge post. The existing leaf stays and $370 covers swing and latch testing.
homeowner_estimate: Gate and hinge-post repair — $370. I’ll reset the moving hinge post, rehang the existing gate and test its swing and latch. The ground grade stays as it is.

contractor_review: Keep the date open until the owner's contractor completes the approved anchors. The owner supplies the kit.
homeowner_estimate: Pergola kit assembly — $700 labor. You supply the kit and have your contractor install the approved anchors. Once the anchors are ready we’ll agree on the assembly date. I’ll assemble the kit at that location.

contractor_review: The base was checked and found firm. The price is limited to the 16 sq ft repair by the step. One local landscape specialist has a $1,500 repair minimum. That is its dispatch policy, not a reason to change your $260 small-job offer.
homeowner_estimate: Paver repair by the step — $260 fixed. I’ll lift and reuse the pavers in the 16 sq ft repair area, correct the bedding so the pavers sit firmly and restore the joints.

contractor_review: The path begins outside the existing patio. 4 × 18 ft = 72 sq ft, extended at $20/sq ft. A landscape specialist’s $5,000 project floor can exceed this entire walkway; verify that your $1,440 covers base, access and spoil removal before sending. Do not import its minimum.
homeowner_estimate: New paver path — $1,440. I’ll install a 4 × 18 ft path from the edge of the patio toward the raised beds. The 72 sq ft at $20/sq ft includes stripping turf, compacting the base, installing pavers and edges, and disposing of spoil. The existing patio stays.

contractor_review: Keep the price per completed visit. Normal growth is confirmed for the first visit; no season total is agreed. Chicago ten-day completed bookings sampled at $35–42 without identical lot size. Keep the agreed $55 rather than cutting it to a city average.
homeowner_estimate: Lawn mowing every ten days — $55 per completed visit. I’ll mow the front and back lawns, trim the fence line and blow the driveway clear.

contractor_review: Both beds total 192 sq ft. Three inches equals about 1.78 cubic yards in place. Do not change the $290 fixed price to a yard rate.
homeowner_estimate: Mulch delivery and installation — $290 fixed. I’ll supply, deliver and spread mulch 3 inches deep over both existing 8 × 12 ft beds. Bed cutting and planting are outside this scope.

contractor_review: The owner changed the debris destination. The price includes chipping on site and leaving the chips.
homeowner_estimate: Hedge trimming — $210. I’ll trim 30 linear ft of ground-accessible hedge, chip the branches on site and leave the chips by your shed.

contractor_review: The 90 sq ft patch is the entire repair area. The $330 includes initial watering, and ongoing watering is the owner’s job.
homeowner_estimate: Trench lawn repair — $330. I’ll prepare the marked 90 sq ft strip, install sod and water it once. You’ll take over watering after installation. I’ll start once the plumber hands over settled, ready backfill; if it needs more work, we’ll agree on that first.

contractor_review: Quote diagnosis alone. A valve replacement depends on the findings and separate authorization.
homeowner_estimate: Sprinkler zone diagnosis — $95. I’ll investigate why the affected zone won’t run and show you what I find. If a repair is needed, I’ll give you its price and obtain your approval before starting it.

contractor_review: The owner selected a temporary aboveground solution. The unverified outlet prevents committing to a buried run.
homeowner_estimate: Temporary downspout extension — $85. I’ll supply and attach an aboveground extension to carry discharge farther from the house. The price covers that extension only, with no buried line or assurance that all ponding will clear.

contractor_review: Keep the detached garage out. The $195 includes checking flow and bagging debris into the owner’s bin.
homeowner_estimate: House gutter cleaning — $195. I’ll clean the house gutters, check downspout flow and put the bagged debris in your bin. We’ll skip the detached garage while its roof is awaiting replacement.

contractor_review: No source confirmed. The $125 inspection covers reporting findings only.
homeowner_estimate: Window joint inspection — $125. I’ll inspect the exposed exterior joints and report what I can see about the wind-driven rain. If I identify work to recommend, we’ll agree on the scope and price before any sealing or repairs.

contractor_review: Use the two compatible owner spares. Weathered color variation is accepted and exposed attachment is part of the repair.
homeowner_estimate: Vinyl siding repair — $190. I’ll check the exposed attachment points and fit the two compatible replacement strips you supply. The spares may look different beside the weathered siding. The repair is limited to those two strips.

contractor_review: The owner arranges a qualified wall assessment. No repair, rebuilding or price is authorized.
homeowner_estimate: Retaining wall assessment handoff. Please arrange a qualified assessment of the leaning wall. There is no contractor work to approve or price at this stage.
